notes: Budgeted delivery E2, reader replays over the deliver cells' frozen contexts (copied to .e2-transfer/<benchmark>/deliver). The LongMemEval-S cells are local (the lease proxy runs on this host, four shards at a time); the LoCoMo and BEAM readers run on one VM, which copies the deliver outputs into its pulled output. Only one phase 2 cell runs: the one for the frontier candidate the readings name.

cells.lease_basis: estimate $71: Sonnet 5.5 on 5 arms x 500 questions about $0.022 each with the judge ($55), the window arm and the four 16,000-token sweep arms on the slice ($16); lease about 3x (Garry 2026-10-09)
cells.command: export GBRAIN_EVALS_QA_CACHE="$SHOOTOUT_OUT/qa-cache" E2_PARALLEL_MAX=4 && bash eval/runner/budgeted-delivery/e2-parallel.sh 16 .e2-transfer/lme-s/deliver -- --benchmark lme-s --system gbrain-query --embed hash --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --config search.reranker.enabled=false --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_sha}}" --policy-setting variants=e2 --policy-setting stage=deliver --policy-setting b_pseudo={{b_pseudo_lme_s}} --policy-setting b_native={{b_native_lme_s}} --policy-setting b16_pseudo={{b16_pseudo_lme_s}} --frozen-from .e2-transfer/lme-s/frozen.ndjson --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-09-gbrain-budgeted-delivery-e2/manifests/arms/lme-s-phase1.json --replay

cells.lease_basis: estimate $66: Sonnet 5.5 on 4 arms x 587 LoCoMo questions ($54) and 4 arms x 120 BEAM questions ($12), with the judges; lease about 3x (Garry 2026-10-09)
cells.command: export GBRAIN_EVALS_QA_CACHE="$SHOOTOUT_OUT/qa-cache" && cp -r .e2-transfer/locomo/deliver "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/locomo" && cp -r .e2-transfer/beam-100k/deliver "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/beam-100k" && ( bash eval/runner/budgeted-delivery/e2-parallel.sh 3 "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/locomo" -- --benchmark locomo --split dev --system gbrain-query --embed hash --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --config search.reranker.enabled=false --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_sha}}" --policy-setting variants=e2 --policy-setting stage=deliver --policy-setting deliver_set=primary --policy-setting b_pseudo={{b_pseudo_locomo}} --frozen-from .e2-transfer/locomo/frozen.ndjson --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-09-gbrain-budgeted-delivery-e2/manifests/arms/locomo.json --replay ) & pa=$!; ( bash eval/runner/budgeted-delivery/e2-parallel.sh 6 "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/beam-100k" -- --benchmark beam-100k --split dev --system gbrain-query --embed hash --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --config search.reranker.enabled=false --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_sha}}" --policy-setting variants=e2 --policy-setting stage=deliver --policy-setting deliver_set=primary --policy-setting b_pseudo={{b_pseudo_beam_100k}} --frozen-from .e2-transfer/beam-100k/frozen.ndjson --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-09-gbrain-budgeted-delivery-e2/manifests/arms/beam-100k.json --replay ) & pb=$!; wait $pa; ra=$?; wait $pb; rb=$?; exit $((ra | rb))
cells.setup_command: BUN_VERSION=1.4.2 bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh setup --datasets locomo,beam-100k && { test -d "$HOME/gbrain-master/.git" || git clone -q https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master"; } && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" fetch -q origin {{gbrain_sha}} && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" checkout -q {{gbrain_sha}}
